description: Replace one of a class's 8 parameter growth curves. paramId is 0-7 ([maxHP,maxMP,atk,def,mat,mdf,agi,luk]); values must match the existing curve length (same max level).

classId.description: The ID of the class to edit

dryRun.description: Preview only: return a diff of what would change without writing to disk.

paramId.description: Which param: 0 maxHP,1 maxMP,2 atk,3 def,4 mat,5 mdf,6 agi,7 luk

values.description: New curve, indexed by level; must match the existing curve length

name: set_class_param_curve
